Package businesslogic

Class ClientBL

java.lang.Object
businesslogic.ClientBL
public class ClientBL extends Object
Business Logic Layer class for managing Client entities. Acts as an intermediary between the user interface and the data access layer, handling validation rules and core business operations for clients. * @author Yasmina
